name: SynapLogic
fix_description: The buy function (0x670a3267) accepts an address[] refBy parameter giving each referral 10% of the payment. No validation prevents duplicate addresses or self-referral. Attacker passes refBy=[self]*31, receiving 310% back. Fix by requiring unique non-sender addresses in refBy and capping total referral payout below 100%.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very straightforward parameter-abuse exploit: it passes arrays with repeated recipients, fixed refund rates, and refund flags to drain excess ETH/USDC in a single call per path. It requires little protocol-specific DeFi knowledge, no flash loans or complex routing, and the exploit logic is simple enough for an experienced auditor to reproduce quickly.
